parole.significato: Something or someone that spoils an otherwise enjoyable event.
parole.testo: From craic (borrowed from Irish craic, itself borrowed from Northern English crack, inherited from Middle English crak (“loud conversation, bragging talk”)) + killer.

parole.significato: A ditch, especially a field boundary ditch usually used to drain fields and mark their boundaries.
parole.testo: From Irish seoch, from English sough.
